admission.justification: Treating a file at the onboarding path as an empty directory would conceal invalid state; one regression checks the exact exception and message across all three route builders.

applicability: The explicit, missing-only and full-quality route-index readers at a selected onboarding path.
conditions: The code root is admitted as a live directory before the onboarding path is surveyed; an existing non-directory onboarding path triggers the refusal, and an absent path yields a successful zero-route survey.
exclusions: Converted drift errors use their own status response; this invariant describes the route-index exception boundary.

evidence: A002-focused.txt: 29 cases; A002-failing-before.txt captures the prior false refusal; same test checks three builders.

statement: The route-index readers refuse an existing non-directory onboarding path with NotADirectoryError and a message identifying the non-directory; an absent onboarding path remains an empty collection.
